title: ACIS shared pointer-row validation cache fast slice
scope: Avoid rebuilding and rescanning resolved ACIS pointer rows during rooted body projection
Preserve per-use owner/type checks, graph-link order, and output accounting
Add a tight-budget generated shared-graph regression without external files

changes.implementation: drw_extractAcisBodyWireframes now validates each immutable source node's Pointer-token to resolved refs correspondence once per node, admits the validation-cache entry through the existing extraction-item budget, and returns a lightweight view over DRW_AcisNode::refs. Per-owner checks and emitted graph links remain evaluated per use. This avoids repeated token scans and temporary pointer-vector copies on shared graphs.
changes.test: A generated two-body/shared-lump graph runs under maxOutputItems=50 and compares body/root counts, reachable-node order, and graph-link rows against the default-budget projection.

validation.limitations: The change removes repeated pointer-row validation/copy work only; it is not a whole-process memory bound or ACIS semantic support promotion. The local tree contains broad pre-existing uncommitted goal work, so this slice is documented but not committed or staged.

assessment.nextLocalBoundary: Continue the existing 7S.3/S3.7 bounded retention/accounting queue with one repeated or unaccounted owner at a time; run only its owning focused test and update the tracker after that slice.
